issues.description: Method de.tum.cit.ase.Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML in problem_statement.md (line 28) and the task description (line 85) present messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (UML shows '+ messageOnFeed():String' and the task asks to define messageOnFeed() as abstract). The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares the method with protected visibility: 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed();' (line 18). This creates an inconsistency about the expected API: students reading the UML/task will expect a public abstract method, while the reference code uses protected, which may confuse students about required visibility and test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferably update the solution implementation to match the UML/problem statement by changing the method signature in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java from 'protected abstract String messageOnFeed();' to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();'. Alternatively, if protected was intentional, update the UML and task text to indicate protected visibility and explain the reason to students.
